transcript:
[00:00] Priya: Hey, everyone, welcome to our June all-hands, um, happy Friday. We'll get started in a minute while folks join. Thanks for being here.
[00:18] Priya: Quick housekeeping - this meeting is recorded, captions are on, and please put questions in the Q&A or drop in Slack afterwards.
[00:35] Alex: Hi all, Alex here - quick engineering highlight, we shipped 2x throughput improvements on the inference runtime for short chat prompts, not to be confused with the longer context benchmarks. There are still a few edge cases with KV cashing - sorry, KV cache - where warm starts don't always behave, we're tracking those.
[00:58] Priya: Nice, that was big for customers who use hosted API heavily. Revenue note: Q2 ARR growth was in line with expectations, upsells are up, and we're pacing toward our target but we'll talk details in a moment.
[01:20] Marisol: Product - we focused this quarter on reliability (re: Dedicated and Private customers) and launched the first iteration of the Optimize recommendations engine as a beta. It's helping a handful of customers reduce per-token cost by around 18% on average - results vary by workload.
[01:45] Audience (someone off-mic): Can you repeat the cost number?
[01:49] Marisol: Sure, about 18% average reduction for the beta cohort, some saw as high as 30% with aggressive quantization + caching.
[02:05] Samir: On SRE, the June 8th latency incident - we saw a chain: network flapping in one of our colo providers triggered autoscaler thrash, which led to increased tail latency for a 25% subset of requests for about 22 minutes.
[02:30] Samir: We'll publish the RCA; immediate mitigation was routing policy changes and removing the affected pool from rotations.
[02:44] Alex: Just to add, a couple of the model kernel selections didn't handle the burst pattern, and we had suboptimal batching thresholds which increased queuing. We're improving our kernel selector heuristics and adding better load-shedding.
[03:05] Priya: Ok, thanks. On hiring - we are enacting a temporary hiring pause for non-critical roles to conserve runway; exceptions are for revenue-generating roles and key infra positions. People team will outline the process.
[03:25] Lena: We'll share the exception flow and timelines in the next 48 hours, and managers should expect guidance on open reqs.
[03:38] Ethan: Sales - pipeline is healthy, but procurement cycles are slowing in some enterprise accounts. We're pushing pilots to Dedicated for customers that need consistent latency and want single-tenant isolation.
[03:55] Rina: CS is seeing increased asks around SOC 2 attestations, audit logs, and KMS integrations. We're prioritizing a security pack in docs and sales playbook.
[04:15] Priya: On compliance, our SOC 2 Type 2 is in progress and we expect the report in Q3; we also have a roadmap item for expanded KMS/HSM integrations for Private customers.
[04:34] Audience Q&A: "Will Dedicated customers get the same Optimize features?"
[04:39] Marisol: Yes, Optimize is intended to be available across Hosted and Dedicated; the recommendation engine will include quantization profiles and batching suggestions tuned per deployment. For Private we need to handle telemetry constraints, so some signals will be on by opt-in.
[05:05] Speaker 1 (someone from Eng): Was there any customer impact beyond latency - like wrong completions or token truncation?
[05:12] Samir: We saw increased errors on a small number of requests due to KV cache invalidation races. No data leakage, but some responses returned earlier-than-expected truncations. We're rolling a fix to avoid races between cache eviction and kernel swap.
[05:36] Priya: Quick finance update - burn is stable relative to plan thanks to efficiency wins, but we want to be cautious this year. We're tightening non-essential spend and focusing on product-led growth motions.
[05:56] Marisol: Roadmap highlight - Q3 focus areas: 1) Scale Optimize from beta to GA, 2) finish Dedicated autoscaling policies and burst capacity improvements, 3) Private deployment UX and onboarding docs, and 4) better cost attribution in Console.
[06:25] Alex: A technical note - we're rolling out a new kernel profiler which should reduce kernel selection time by ~40%, and that helps tail latency. Also researching GPU memory tiering and quantized execution paths.
[06:50] Audience comment: Nice.
[06:55] Priya: Ok let's do a short leadership lightning round - heads, quick wins and asks. Alex?
[07:05] Alex: Win: runtime throughput improvement shipped. Ask: Engineering - please prioritize the incident mitigation items in the top 10 ops bugs.
[07:20] Daniel: Win: onboarding flow for Dedicated customers improved, time-to-first-success down 20%. Ask: Support samples and better telemetry to reduce triage time.
[07:40] Marisol: Win: Optimize beta feedback is actionable. Ask: Product needs clear top-10 customer asks to prioritize features.
[08:00] Lena: Win: successful manager training session for performance reviews. Ask: Teams, file calibration notes earlier.
[08:15] Ethan: Win: closed two mid-market expansion deals. Ask: Sales, please coordinate with CS for onboarding resources.
[08:30] Rina: Win: reduced NPS churn signals. Ask: CS to provide advocacy cases for sales demos.
[08:45] Audience: Quick question about data residency for APAC customers?
[08:50] Alex: We are expanding available regions via partner colos; Private customers can deploy in-region but hosted requires region-specific capacity. We're prioritizing APAC in the roadmap.
[09:08] Speaker 2 (employee): Are there any layoffs?
[09:12] Priya: No. There's a hiring pause for many non-critical roles, but we are not doing reductions at this time. We'll be transparent and share details.
[09:27] Audience: Um, can the SRE team share more on the RCA?
[09:32] Samir: Yes, I'll post a detailed RCA in the ops channel and schedule a follow-up technical deep-dive next week for folks who want more detail.
[09:44] Priya: Ok, last part: shoutouts. Please add kudos in Donut, and remember the all-hands will be up on the intranet with closed captions.
[10:00] Priya: Thanks everyone, meeting adjourned.
